headline: Drivers set to save as petrol prices launch on Google Maps
summary_en: Google Maps will show near real-time petrol and diesel prices so drivers can save at the pump.
summary_zh: 谷歌地图将显示近乎实时的汽油和柴油价格，帮助司机节省油费。
watch_en: Near real-time petrol and diesel prices are included on Google Maps for the first time.
watch_zh: 谷歌地图首次纳入近乎实时的汽油和柴油价格。
excerpt: Drivers to save at the pump as near real-time petrol and diesel prices are included on Google Maps for the first time.
